title: Merged cells grid odt 001
notes: real ODF covered-cell merges (ODF 1.2 §9.4): table:number-rows-spanned="2" on cell A1 with a covered:table-cell placeholder in the same column of row 2, plus table:number-columns-spanned="2" on A3 with a covered:table-cell to its right in row 3; covered: is the mandated prefix for the table namespace URI. Reference text lists each surviving cell's text once in row-major order (covered cells carry no text).
